title: Kavita Devi v. Land Acquisition Officer
text: The petitioner, Kavita Devi, challenged the land acquisition proceedings under Article 226 of the Constitution alleging that the Land Acquisition Officer awarded inadequate compensation for her agricultural land acquired for a highway project. The court, exercising jurisdiction under Article 226, finds that the Land Acquisition Officer did not properly apply the market value formula. A writ of mandamus is issued directing reconsideration of the compensation. The fundamental right to property as a legal right under Article 300A requires payment of fair compensation. The court also notes that the acquisition did not comply with rehabilitation provisions under the Right to Fair Compensation Act. The petitioner is entitled to enhanced compensation and benefits under the rehabilitation package. The High Court directs fresh compensation assessment.
